summary: Prepay Rs 3 lakh of a Rs 18.4 lakh home loan at 9.1% with 168 months left, keeping the EMI.
split_note: Discovery (D53): v1's traces on this task are where prompt v2's changes may come from.

messages.content: I have ₹18,40,000 left on my home loan at 9.1%, with 168 months to go. I'm getting a ₹3 lakh bonus. If I prepay it and keep my EMI the same, how much interest do I save and how much sooner am I done?

graders.description: The judge (rubric advice.v1, D68): yes/no criteria, each answered on its own with a quote; optional until each passes the trust bar on held-out labels (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the advisor explain each key figure in plain words, so this client would understand what it means for them? Yes or no.

judge_criteria_to_write: Judgment: does it check the client keeps an emergency buffer before prepaying everything?
